help: These powers reflect your ability to give clear directions and inspire others in combat. The Leadership pool offers many toggle powers for individual and group buffs. Every power you take from Leadership grants 1.2 Confusion resistance.
power_short_helps: Toggle: PBAoE, Team +To Hit, Res(Confuse, Fear), +Perception
Delayed Targeted AOE Moderate Lethal Damage
Single Target Nonstacking +Control, +Res(All), Heal Over Time
